ctx.x: Yeah. But those guys are just bending and shaping the music. I mean, if you hear somebody really being himself in the baritone part, you know?

items.q: Jerome Drummer had a big sound, too.

ctx.x: Well, that was the reason for it. Jerome Drummer had a big sound, too.

Yeah, he did. Anyway, that's a great record. The -- let me ask you about some music that I know very well, that I -- you had an enormous success in Monterey the first year, and when you went back out to California to do Monterey the second year, through -- well, you might tell the circumstances of that second year. But you had some extraordinary music to play. And the result was that you didn't play it there, at Monterey.
